mixing times of organic compounds are often longer than 1 h within SOA particles in the global planetary boundary layer, and this is particularly true in the tropics, at high relative humidity, and at low temperature.

, in the global tropics, mixing times are often longer than 1 h, which means that the assumption that organic molecules are uniformly mixed within SOA is likely to be violated in these regions.
